summary: Inhibrx Biosciences, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026, furnished with a press release and corporate presentation. Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclose updated interim clinical data from a Phase 1/2 study of ozekibart (INBRX-109) in combination with FOLFIRI for colorectal cancer. The efficacy data show a 20% ORR, 5.5-month median PFS, and 87% DCR in heavily pretreated patients. This is a routine clinical update, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, board actions, or structural changes are involved; the filing simply reports trial results to the market.
